entry.title: Brice Turang: “You going to let $1 million stand in the way of signing a Hall of Famer?" One of of my favorite tales of the '26 Brewers, from Bob Nightengale early in the season. Did Brice Turang really say it? We got to witness him and Matt Arnold hash it out. www.mlb.com/brewers/news...

Milwaukee Brewers roster moves and needs: The Brewers announced the BBWAA's Milwaukee chapter award winners. Most Valuable Player: Brice Turang Most Valuable Pitcher: Jacob Misiorowski (unanimous) Most Valuable Newcomer: Cooper Pratt Unsung Hero: Abner Uribe Good Guy Award: Christian Yelich How would you have voted?
William Contreras: Brewers exercise William Contreras’ option, extend qualifying offer to Jake Bauers in start of offseason moves

Milwaukee Brewers staff and front office: The World Series champion Brewers have four players who landed among the three finalists for BBWAA awards: Brice Turang: NL MVP Jacob Misiorowski: NL Cy Young Trevor Megill: NL Relief Pitcher of the Year Pat Murphy: NL Manager of the Year www.mlb.com/brewers/news...
Dustin May: Dustin May declined his mutual option with the Brewers and is a free agent
